Name: Better Movement And Combat
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#f6b26b][b][size=6]Better Movement and Combat[/size][/b][/color][/center]

[center][size=5]Auto face and swing, free movement, extended reach, smart tool swap.[/size][/center]

[line]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49065/49065-1784323016-1968354997.jpg[/img][/center]
[line]

[b][size=5]Auto Swing[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Hold attack to repeat swings for swords, clubs, and daggers.[/*]
[*]Faces cursor direction before each swing (mouse and controller).[/*]
[*]Per-weapon-type toggle.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Movement[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Move while using melee weapons, tools, and slingshot.[/*]
[*]Move during special attacks and charged tools.[/*]
[*]Configurable movement speed multiplier while using items.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Extended Reach[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Tool range extends toward cursor position.[/*]
[*]Configurable max reach (0.5 to 5 tiles).[/*]
[*]Can target tiles beneath the player.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Smart Swap[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Auto-equip the right tool when clicking objects.[/*]
[*]Detection modes: Cursor (tile under mouse) or Player (tile in front of player).[/*]
[*]Configurable toggle key (default Z) with in-game on/off notification.[/*]
[*][b]Axe[/b] - trees, stumps, logs, twigs, bushes. Option to skip saplings.[/*]
[*][b]Pickaxe[/b] - stone, ore, boulders.[/*]
[*][b]Hoe[/b] - artifact spots, diggable soil.[/*]
[*][b]Watering Can[/b] - unwatered crops, pet bowl.[/*]
[*][b]Scythe[/b] - weeds, grass, moss on trees.[/*]
[*][b]Weapon[/b] - monsters, crates, barrels.[/*]
[*][b]Animals[/b] - milk pail, shears, hay for feeding bench.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b][/center]

Editable in-game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] with page links for each feature category, or directly in [i]config.json[/i].

[line]

[center][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[line]

[center][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract into Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[center][size=5][b]Support[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][url=http://ko-fi.com/yousv][color=#ffd966]Ko-Fi[/color][/url][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=2][i]Report bugs in the Posts/Bugs tab with your SMAPI log.[/i][/size]
